name: g10-12.41.02-search-patient-date
title: 12.41.02 Server returns valid results for Procedure search by patient + date
description: g10 12.41.02 (SH-PAT-2; US Core 6.1.0: group 10.38). Server returns valid results for Procedure search by patient + date. US Core SHALL search. Every result must match every parameter, and the record's Procedure/g10-defib-implant must be among them.

assert.description: Every Procedure returned matches the search

test.name: Comparator gt: GET Procedure?patient=g10-example&date=gt2019-03-25T19:55:26Z
test.description: Every result's date satisfies gt (compared by day). As in Inferno, no result is required.

assert.description: Every Procedure returned matches the search
assert.expression: Bundle.entry.resource.ofType(Procedure).all((subject.reference.endsWith('Patient/g10-example')) and (performed.ofType(dateTime).where($this.toString().substring(0, 10) >= '2019-03-25').exists() or performed.ofType(instant).where($this.toString().substring(0, 10) >= '2019-03-25').exists() or performed.ofType(date).where($this.toString().substring(0, 10) >= '2019-03-25').exists() or performed.ofType(Period).where(end.empty() or end.where($this.toString().substring(0, 10) >= '2019-03-25').exists()).exists()))
